card.text: A Cepheid in the galaxy NGC 4639, 20 million parsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 38.0 days.

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope found it and timed its pulsation at 38.0 days. Its galaxy's distance, 20.2 million parsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.
